name: context-graph
description: Persists file summaries, code implementation relationships, queried/generated data, and tracks token usage per conversation and Git repository.

args: for p in "${extensionPath}/server/mcp_server.py" "./.agents/plugins/context-graph/server/mcp_server.py" "${HOME}/.gemini/config/plugins/context-graph/server/mcp_server.py" "${HOME}/.gemini/extensions/context-graph/server/mcp_server.py" "./server/mcp_server.py"; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then exec python3 "$p"; fi; done; echo 'context-graph mcp_server.py not found' >&2; exit 1
